subject: Cannot connect to VPN from home
description: User reports VPN connection drops after 2 minutes. Running Windows 11, FortiClient 7.2. Error: 'Connection to gateway failed'.
resolution: Updated FortiClient to 7.4.1 and reconfigured split tunneling. Issue resolved.

subject: MFA token not working after phone replacement
description: User replaced their phone and the new device is not receiving MFA push notifications. Cannot access any systems.
resolution: Performed MFA reset via admin console. User re-registered on new device.

subject: Outlook not syncing on MacBook Pro
description: Outlook 365 on macOS stops syncing after ~30 minutes. No error message, emails just stop arriving.
resolution: Cleared Outlook cache and re-added account. Sync stable for 48+ hours.

subject: Need admin rights to install Docker
description: Developer needs local admin rights to install Docker Desktop for a containerization project.
resolution: Granted temporary admin rights for 48 hours via PAM. Docker installed successfully.

subject: Password expired, cannot log in
description: User's domain password expired overnight. Getting 'password must be changed' prompt but the reset link doesn't work on mobile.
resolution: Reset password via self-service portal on desktop. User confirmed login works.

subject: Printer on 3rd floor not printing
description: HP LaserJet M452 on 3rd floor shows 'Ready' but jobs stay in queue. Tried restarting printer and spooler.
resolution: Replaced network cable. Print queue cleared and test page printed.

subject: Request access to SAP Finance module
description: User needs read access to SAP Finance module for quarterly budget review.
resolution: Manager approved. Access granted to SAP FI module with read-only role.

subject: Laptop fan making grinding noise
description: ThinkPad X1 fan is making a loud grinding noise. Laptop is 3 years old.
resolution: Scheduled hardware replacement. Loaner laptop provided.

subject: Suspicious email with attachment
description: User received an email claiming to be from IT asking them to open an attachment and enter credentials.
resolution: Confirmed phishing attempt. Email reported to security team. User did not open attachment.

subject: Cannot access SharePoint team site
description: User gets 'Access Denied' when trying to open the Engineering team SharePoint site.
resolution: User was removed from group during org change. Re-added to Engineering group.

subject: Slow laptop performance after Windows update
description: Laptop takes 5+ minutes to boot after latest Windows update. Task Manager shows 100% disk usage.
resolution: Disabled SysMain service and updated storage drivers. Boot time back to 45 seconds.

subject: Need Zoom installed for client calls
description: User needs Zoom desktop client for external client video calls starting next week.
resolution: Zoom 6.1 installed via software center. Test call successful.

subject: Two monitors not detected after dock firmware update
description: After updating the Thunderbolt dock firmware, only one external monitor is detected.
resolution: Rolled back dock firmware to previous version. Both monitors detected.

subject: VPN disconnects every 10 minutes on hotel Wi-Fi
description: VPN connection unstable on hotel Wi-Fi during business travel. Works fine on home network.
resolution: Changed VPN protocol from SSL to IPSec for hotel networks. Stable connection.

subject: Forgot password, locked out after 3 attempts
description: User forgot new password and got locked out after 3 failed attempts.
resolution: Account unlocked and password reset via helpdesk. User confirmed access.

subject: Excel crashing when opening large files
description: Excel 365 crashes when opening files larger than 50MB. No error message.
resolution: Increased virtual memory allocation and disabled hardware acceleration. Stable.

subject: Need access to network share for project files
description: User needs read/write access to \\fileserver\projects\alpha for the Alpha project.
resolution: Manager approved. Added to Alpha project group with RW access.

subject: Wi-Fi drops when moving between floors
description: Laptop loses Wi-Fi connection when user moves between floors. Needs to reconnect manually.
resolution: Updated wireless drivers and enabled fast roaming. Seamless handoff between APs.

subject: USB-C dock not charging laptop
description: USB-C dock provides display and USB but doesn't charge the laptop. Worked yesterday.
resolution: Power delivery circuit in dock failed. Replaced dock under warranty.

subject: How to set up email on personal phone
description: User wants to set up work email on their personal iPhone. BYOD policy allows this.
resolution: Sent KB article on iOS email setup with Intune enrollment. User completed setup.

subject: MFA push notifications not arriving after phone upgrade
description: User replaced handset. Authenticator re-enrolled but push prompts never arrive. Blocking all system access.

subject: VPN drops every 10 minutes from the headquarters office
description: Repeated disconnects on the wired network. FortiClient 7.4.1. Affects three users on the same switch.

subject: Request access to the procurement share drive
description: Needs read access to the vendor capability statements folder to review a submission.

subject: Suspicious email requesting credential re-entry
description: User received a mail impersonating IT with a link to a credential form. Did not click. Reported for triage.
